record.what_it_does: REST API and MCP service that extracts YouTube video transcripts, searches YouTube, browses channels, and lists playlists — serving 15M+ transcripts monthly.
record.auth_notes: REST API uses Bearer token (API key). MCP supports OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration (Claude) and Static Client Registration (ChatGPT).
record.access_notes: Free trial: 100 credits, no credit card required, expires after 90 days. Paid plans start at $5/month (1,000 credits) or $54/year.
